articles.title: Michael J. Fox emociona con su discurso en los Emmy 2026: "Aceptar el Parkinson no significaba que tuviera que rendirme"
articles.standfirst: El cinco veces ganador del Emmy fue reconocido en este caso por sus contribuciones a la defensa y la investigación de la enfermedad de Parkinson
articles.summary: El cinco veces ganador del Emmy fue reconocido en este caso por sus contribuciones a la defensa y la investigación de la enfermedad de Parkinson
articles.body: Michael J. Fox convive con su enfermedad, la del Parkinson, muchos años y cada vez que aparece es el fiel reflejo de la lucha y la ganas de estar. Lo ha vuelto a hacer en un escenario como el de los Premios Emmy 2026. El veterano actor recibió recibió el Premio Humanitario Bob Hope, un galardón que se ha entregado en seis ocasiones desde su creación, y dejó a todos con los sentimientos a flor de piel. Su discurso marcó esta gala. "Al principio, mantuve en secreto mi diagnóstico de Parkinson. Me preocupaba que afectara a mi trabajo y mi relación con el público. Me sorprendió el apoyo de todo el mundo, me sentí muy animado. Comprendí que aceptar la enfermedad no significaba que tuviera que rendirme. Tenía que hacer todo lo posible por todos los que viven con esto", manifestó el actor. Seguidamente añadió: "Me propuse abogar por la enfermedad de Parkinson y recaudar fondos. Encontré personas que lideraran esta iniciativa y me comprometí a financiar la mejor investigación científica del mundo. Estoy orgulloso del progreso que hemos logrado en beneficio de los pacientes y sus familias. Nos acercamos cada vez más a la erradicación definitiva de la enfermedad. Estoy profundamente agradecido a nuestro personal, donantes, investigadores y la comunidad de pacientes que hacen posible nuestro trabajo en la Fundación Michael J. Fox". La Fundación Michael J. Fox para la Investigación del Parkinson nació en el año 2000 poco después de hacer público su diagnóstico, que conoció en 1991 a los 29 años, a una edad extremadamente joven. Por ello, el cinco veces ganador del Emmy fue reconocido en este caso por sus contribuciones a la defensa y la investigación de la enfermedad de Parkinson.

articles.title: Márcio Victor chora ao descobrir indicação do Psirico ao Grammy Latino | G1
articles.standfirst: Grupo baiano concorre na categoria Melhor Álbum de Música de Raízes em Língua Portuguesa com ‘Molho Lambão’. Premiação acontece em novembro, em Las Vegas.
articles.summary: Grupo baiano concorre na categoria Melhor Álbum de Música de Raízes em Língua Portuguesa com ‘Molho Lambão’. Premiação acontece em novembro, em Las Vegas.
articles.body:
O cantor baiano Márcio Victor, vocalista do Psirico, chorou ao descobrir que o grupo baiano foi indicado ao Grammy Latino 2026. O cantor recebeu a notícia enquanto voltava dos Estados Unidos para Salvador , nesta quarta-feira (16), e comemorou ao telefone com a mãe e um amigo que estava na aeronave.

“Mainha, mainha. Cadê a senhora, mainha?”, diz Márcio Victor, emocionado, antes de revelar a novidade. “O Grammy! A gente foi indicado, Dudu!”, comemora.

Em seguida, o cantor celebra a realização do que considera um sonho antigo. “Eu sabia, véi, que a gente ia chegar um dia”, afirma.

Márcio Victor chora ao descobrir indicação do Psirico ao Grammy Latino 2026 — Foto: Reprodução/Redes Sociais

A reação chamou a atenção de um passageiro que estava sentado ao lado do artista. “Acabou de ser indicado ao Grammy?”, pergunta. Na sequência, ele parabeniza Márcio Victor.

O Psirico foi indicado na categoria Melhor Álbum de Música de Raízes em Língua Portuguesa pelo trabalho “Molho Lambão”. O grupo disputa o prêmio com Carminho, João Gomes, Mestrinho e Jota.pê, Juliana Linhares e Zaynara.

A indicação foi anunciada pela Academia Latina da Gravação nesta quarta-feira. A cerimônia da 27ª edição do Grammy Latino está marcada para 12 de novembro, em Las Vegas , nos Estados Unidos.

Além do Psirico, outros artistas baianos também aparecem entre os indicados ao Grammy Latino 2026.

A cantora Luedji Luna concorre na categoria Melhor Álbum de Pop Contemporâneo em Língua Portuguesa com “Antes Que A Terra Acabe”. Já Simone Mendes foi indicada a Melhor Álbum de Música Sertaneja com “Cantando Sua História 2 (Ao Vivo)”.

O cantor e compositor baiano Carlinhos Brown está entre os artistas ligados às indicações deste ano, apesar de não ter sido oficialmente indicado. Ele é um dos compositores de “Sua Onda”, de Marisa Monte, indicada na categoria Melhor Canção em Língua Portuguesa.

articles.title: Sridevi property dispute: Supreme Court issues notice to Boney Kapoor, Janhvi Kapoor and Khushi Kapoor over 2.70-acre land bought by the late actress in Chennai
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has issued notices to producer Boney Kapoor and his daughters, Janhvi Kapoor and Khushi Kapoor, in connection with a plea seeking to.
articles.body: The Supreme Court has issued notices to producer Boney Kapoor and his daughters, Janhvi Kapoor and Khushi Kapoor, in connection with a plea seeking to reopen a long-standing property dispute over land purchased by late actress Sridevi and her family in Chennai. The disputed property spans 2.70 acres.Supreme Court orders status quo, suggests mediationAccording to an IANS report, a bench comprising Justices K.V. Viswanathan and Arun Pillai took up a petition filed by M.C. Sivakami and her brother, M.C. Natarajan, who have staked a claim to a portion of the disputed property.The court directed both sides to maintain the status quo with regard to the property until the next hearing. It also suggested that the matter be resolved through mediation and proposed that a retired High Court judge oversee the process.The case has been scheduled for December 18, when the court will review the progress of the mediation.Background: Madras High Court’s April rulingThe Sivakami siblings approached the Supreme Court after the Madras High Court, on April 20, ruled in favour of the Kapoor family by allowing their revision petition and dismissing the civil suit filed by the siblings.The High Court concluded that the challenge to property transactions dating back to 1988 could not proceed as it was barred by limitation. It also held that the plaintiffs’ claims lacked sufficient legal basis based on the submissions before the court.What the land dispute involvesThe disputed property is located at Survey No. 1/1B in Sholinganallur, Chennai.According to details recorded by the Madras High Court, the petitioners identified themselves as the legal heirs of late M.C. Chandrasekaran and sought division of the property into five equal parts, claiming a one-fifth share for themselves.They also sought to invalidate sale deeds executed on April 19, 1988, in favour of Rajeshwari, Sreelatha and Sridevi, along with subsequent transactions relating to the property.Arguments before the Supreme CourtRepresenting the petitioners, their counsel argued that the High Court had examined complex questions, including whether the claimants were legitimate legal heirs and the validity of Chandrasekaran’s alleged second marriage, at a stage when the court was only required to determine whether the plaint should be rejected at the threshold.Representing the Kapoor family, senior advocate Abhishek Manu Singhvi pointed out that the original transaction took place in 1988, while the present suit was filed only in 2025.He further noted that the petitioners had attained adulthood in 1995 and 1999, respectively, and argued that the delay in filing the suit meant that the claim was beyond the permissible limitation period.The Supreme Court also sought clarity on whether Chandrasekaran held a one-fifth share in the property and whether there was any dispute regarding the petitioners being his biological children.Case’s legal historyThe dispute originated with a suit filed before the Additional District Judge in Chengalpattu. The trial court had initially refused to reject the plaint under Order VII Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure, holding that the contents of the plaint needed to be examined during the trial rather than at the preliminary stage.The Madras High Court subsequently reversed that decision on April 20, 2026.Justice T.V. Thamilselvi, presiding over a single-judge bench, held that the petitioners’ claim of having discovered the disputed transaction only in 2023 was not supported by the evidence on record. The court concluded that the challenge to the 1988 transactions was barred by limitation and ordered the plaint to be rejected.The High Court also noted that the same plaintiffs had filed an earlier suit in 2007 seeking a one-fifth share in family assets, which had been dismissed at the time.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: From Konkan to Karachi: Marathi tradition of Ganeshotsav celebrated across the border, too
articles.summary: Marathi-speaking families in Karachi celebrate Ganeshotsav with 700 devotees, a 5-ft handmade idol, daily aarti and a 5km procession to Ratneshwar temple.
articles.body: PUNE: Their ancestors moved from the Maratha heartland to the north during the Third Battle of Panipat circa 1761. Centuries later, after the Partition of 1947, the Marathi-speaking families of many of these travellers’ descendants remained settled in Pakistan. And, even today, they have managed to retain the connect to their Marathi roots. This year, nearly 700 Marathi-speaking Pakistani nationals are celebrating Ganeshotsav in the lanes of Karachi city amid much fanfare.On the first day of the festival, chants of “Ganapati Bappa Moraya” echoed as devotees took out a procession on a 5km stretch from Karachi’s Punjab Colony to Ratneshwar Mahadev temple. This year, the younger generation of Karachi’s Naik family, which has its roots in Maharashtra’s Konkan region, made a 5-ft tall Ganesh idol for the very first time.“We deliberately involved the youngsters in the idol-making process, so that they remain connected to our community’s religious traditions even while staying on this side of the border. From children to senior citizens, all members of our family participated in the activity. We are happy that we could install a 5-ft Lord Ganesha idol this year,” said Mukesh Naik, a member of the Marathi-speaking community of Karachi.The Naik family originally hails from Konkan, where Ganeshotsav has been feted in a traditional manner for centuries. Some members of their family moved to northern regions during the British rule in undivided India. After the Partition, they settled in Pakistan. For generations now, the Naiks have furthered the custom of celebrating Ganeshotsav with others in the community around them.Many such Marathi-speaking families connect with each other socially in Karachi under the umbrella of the Maharashtra Panchayat. Vishal Rajput, another such Marathi-speaking Pakistani national, told TOI on a call, “We want to keep our Marathi traditions alive while living in Pakistan. So, we celebrate every festival of ours — particularly Ganeshotsav — with much enthusiasm. Hundreds of community members here take part.”He added, “For the first time in our history, we are celebrating the festival for seven days at Karachi’s Ganesh Math Mandir. We conduct a daily aarti, distribute modaks and other Marathi traditional sweets as prasad, and will take out a procession with Lord Ganesha’s idol in the city.”Community members said they have expanded this festival’s celebrations in the last few years, including Sindhi and Punjabi-origin residents for the revelry. Organisers said it takes around one month to complete preparations ahead of the festivities.Vinod Daultram, another Marathi-speaking Karachi resident, told TOI, “Preparations begin with the beginning of the month of Shravan. While managing our daily work, we take out some time for idol-making, decorations and prasad preparations.”“This year’s 5ft-tall Ganesha idol was made in the span of a single month. Sculpting the face was the most difficult part. Since we did not have many references in Karachi, we took the help of social media and finally managed to bring out a beautiful idol,” Vinod added.Suman Naik, another Karachi resident, said preparing for this festival felt akin to serving the deity for her. “I painted the Ganesha idol for the first time, and I felt proud that I got the opportunity to connect with our religious tradition and serve god. Younger generations of our community in Pakistan should show enthusiasm for participating in such celebrations to remain connected to their roots.”You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Pune | Silver Rate in Pune | Bank Holidays in Pune | Public Holidays in Pune | Petrol Price in Pune | Diesel Price in Pune | CNG Price in Pune | LPG Price in PuneStay updated with the latest Pune news. articles.title: King Charles responds to Charles Spencer's claims about Princess Diana in a rare statement
articles.summary: King Charles broke royal protocol with a rare palace statement responding to Charles Spencer's explosive claims in his upcoming memoir, "Swan Song."
articles.body:
King Charles responds to claims made by Charles Spencer in his upcoming memoir about Princess Diana's funeral procession.

The 9th Earl of Spencer alleges that King Charles expressed contempt for Diana and her death, claiming that the world would soon forget her.

Buckingham Palace issued a statement on behalf of King Charles, acknowledging the pain of fraternal grief and emphasizing the potential impact on memory and judgment.

King Charles responded to claims made about him in Charles Spencer's upcoming book in an unusual move.

The Daily Mail published an excerpt of Spencer's upcoming memoir, "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister," Wednesday, in which the king's former brother-in-law alleged a heated conversation he had with Charles after the death of his sister and the former Princess of Wales, Princess Diana.

"Prince Charles continued his stream of anger, without me interrupting. Then he stopped. I assumed the pause signaled an effort to bring himself under control, but then he unleashed down the phone what I have always taken to be his pent-up contempt for Diana, and his horror that the world was so bowled over by her death," Spencer alleged, according to the Daily Mail. "'Rest assured,' he hissed, 'we'll forget her soon enough!'"

According to the excerpt, the disagreement between King Charles and the 9th Earl of Spencer was regarding the decision to have Prince William and Prince Harry, then 15 and 12, walk behind their mother's casket during the funeral procession.

A Buckingham Palace spokesperson issued a rare statement on behalf of the king responding to Spencer's claims.

"While we do not comment on books as a matter of principle, His Majesty is mindful that the pain of fraternal grief can cloud reason, affect judgment and color memory in ways others do not recognize, even many years after such a loss," the statement said, according to People .

Princess Diana died in August 1997 at age 36 after suffering injuries sustained in a car accident in the Pont de l'Alma tunnel in Paris, France. Her partner, Dodi Fayed, and the driver, Henri Paul, also died in the crash.

At the time of her death, she and King Charles had been divorced for one year. The two married in July 1981, announced their separation in December 1992 and finalized their divorce in August 1996.

Prince Harry wrote about the decision to have him and his brother walk behind their mother's coffin in his 2023 memoir, "Spare," writing that "several adults were aghast" and that "mummy's brother, Uncle Charles, raised hell," and that he told the royal family, "You can't make these boys walk behind their mother's coffin! It's barbaric."

This is not the first time Spencer has spoken about his opposition to the boys walking behind their mother's coffin. He told BBC Radio 4's Today in 2017 that he found the decision "bizarre and cruel."

"It was the most horrifying half an hour of my life," he said. "It was just ghastly. And it was far worse than having to deliver a speech at the end of it. It was the worst part of the day by a considerable margin, walking behind, well, my sister's body, with two boys who were obviously massively grieving their mother.

"And it was this sort of bizarre circumstance where we were told you had to look straight ahead," he continued. "But the feeling, the sort of crashing tidal wave of grief coming at you as you went down this sort of tunnel of deep emotion, it was really harrowing actually, and I still have nightmares about it now."

" Swan Song: Diana, My Sister " is set to be released Sept. 22.

articles.title: In 2008, Leonardo DiCaprio bought a $3.67 million Manhattan apartment inside a building powered by solar panels; what made the Riverhouse different
articles.summary: Explore Leonardo DiCaprio's purchase of a sustainable $3.67 million apartment in Battery Park City's Riverhouse, showcasing luxury living with solar energy and innovative green features.
articles.body: In 2008, Leonardo DiCaprio added a Manhattan apartment to his property portfolio, but the building he chose stood apart from many luxury residences in New York. Located in Battery Park City, Riverhouse was designed around environmentally conscious features, including solar panels, filtered air and a water-treatment system. For an actor who had already become closely associated with environmental causes, the address was a natural fit.At the time, CBS News reported that DiCaprio had purchased an apartment in the 264-unit Riverhouse development, which overlooks the Hudson River and a nearby park. The building was promoted for its focus on reducing its environmental impact while offering the amenities expected from a high-end condominium.A home inside one of Manhattan's early green residential buildingsRiverhouse was completed in 2008 and received LEED Gold certification, according to the Battery Park City Authority. The project was developed by the Sheldrake Organisation, with architecture by Polshek Partnership in collaboration with Ismael Leyva Architects and design work by David Rockwell.Its environmental features were part of the building's design from the beginning. CBS News reported that Riverhouse had low-emission paints, a 24-hour fresh filtered-air system, a water-treatment facility and solar panels that could rotate to follow the sun.The building's approach went beyond simply putting solar panels on the roof. A case study from the Urban Green Council also documents features such as tracking photovoltaic panels, blackwater and rainwater treatment systems, triple-glazed curtain-wall windows and a combined heat-and-power system.How much did Leonardo DiCaprio pay for the apartment?The amount was not disclosed by DiCaprio's representative when the purchase was first reported in April 2008. CBS News confirmed the acquisition but did not publish a purchase price at the time.CityRealty later reported that DiCaprio paid $3.67 million for his first Riverhouse apartment. The actor eventually expanded his presence in the building by purchasing the neighbouring unit in 2014 for $8 million.That second purchase gave him an even larger footprint in the Battery Park City development. CityRealty reported that the neighbouring apartment measured about 2,327 square feet and included approximately 1,035 square feet of outdoor space.The building was designed around cleaner indoor spacesOne of Riverhouse's unusual selling points was its approach to indoor air quality. Rather than relying on ordinary ventilation alone, the building incorporated a filtration system designed to provide residents with fresh, filtered air. CityRealty also reported that the building used water filters, humidity control and low-pollution materials as part of its environmentally focused design.The emphasis on air and water was paired with materials selected with sustainability in mind. The Urban Green Council's case study notes the project's attention to indoor environmental quality and water treatment, showing that these systems were integrated into the development rather than added simply as luxury extras.Solar panels were part of the building's identityThe solar technology was another feature that distinguished Riverhouse when it opened. Reports described the building's solar panels as rotating panels, while the Urban Green Council identified them as tracking photovoltaic panels. Their ability to follow the sun was part of Riverhouse's broader effort to incorporate renewable energy into a high-rise residential project.The building's green credentials were therefore tied to several systems working together: renewable energy, water treatment, air filtration and materials chosen with environmental considerations in mind.A luxury building with plenty beyond its green featuresSustainability did not mean Riverhouse lacked the amenities associated with Manhattan luxury living.The development included a 50-foot lap pool, fitness facilities, a landscaped terrace, media café and dog spa, according to the report. The building also had spaces such as a yoga studio and billiards room.Its waterfront location added another attraction. Riverhouse sits at 2 River Terrace in Battery Park City, overlooking the Hudson River and Rockefeller Park. The Battery Park City Authority lists the building as part of the neighbourhood's North Neighbourhood and confirms its 2008 completion and LEED Gold certification.Leonardo DiCaprio later bought the apartment next doorSix years after his first purchase, DiCaprio returned to Riverhouse. In 2014, he acquired the neighbouring apartment for $8 million, according to CityRealty. The purchase effectively expanded his space within the same environmentally focused development rather than moving to another Manhattan building.The choice also fits a pattern in DiCaprio's real-estate portfolio. Architectural Digest has noted his interest in environmentally conscious properties, including his Battery Park City apartments and his plans for the sustainable Blackadore Caye project in Belize.What made the Riverhouse purchase notable was not simply the celebrity attached to it. In 2008, DiCaprio chose a residence in a building where renewable energy, air filtration and water treatment were built into the development itself. More than a luxury Manhattan address, Riverhouse offered an early example of how sustainability could be incorporated into high-end urban living.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ box office collections day 41: Vishal Chaturvedi’s film joins the Rs 300 crore club despite 27% decline in earnings on Wednesday
articles.summary: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ continues to dominate the box office, crossing the Rs 300 crore milestone in just 41 days. Directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, this spiritual drama sees a slight decline in earnings but maintains a stronghold internationally. Catch up on the latest box office numbers and trends!
articles.body: Written and directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, the heartwarming spiritual drama ‘Hanuman Ansh’ continues keep the cash registers ringing at the box office. After a slow opening but impressive word of mount promotion, the movie picked pace at the box office, achieving new milestones with every passing day. Currently, in its six week, the movie has entered Rs 300 crore club with its gross worldwide collection. While the domestic earnings are inching towards the respective mark, and the movie saw a decline of over 27% on Wednesday, the worldwide gross collection highlighted the stronghold of the film.Read below for more details on the box office collection report of ‘Hanuman Ansh.’‘Hanuman Ansh’ India box office collections day 41Starring Shobhinaw Satyaa in the lead, the movie collected a net of Rs 6 crore across 9,203 shows on day 41, 6th Wednesday, according to Sacnilk. This shows a 27.3% drop from Tuesday’s net earnings of Rs 8.25 crore. After a successful run of 41 days, the movie’s total India net collection has reached Rs 237.13 crore, and the gross earnings have been pushed to Rs 280 crore.‘Hanuman Ansh’ worldwide box office collections day 41A slight decline has been observed in the overseas market as well. The film earned Rs 2 crore on both Monday and Tuesday, but on Wednesday, it went down to Rs 1.75 crore, pushing the overseas gross collection to Rs 20.25 crore. After this, the worldwide gross collection of ‘Hanuman Ansh’ has reached Rs 300.25 crore.‘Hanuman Ansh’ week and day-wise box office collectionWeek 1: Rs 1.08 croreWeek 2: Rs 0.40 croreWeek 3: Rs 10.40 croreWeek 4: Rs 61.00 croreWeek 5: Rs 90.25 croreDay 36 (6th Friday): Rs 10.50 croreDay 37 (6th Saturday): Rs 18.50 croreDay 38 (6th Sunday): Rs 22.50 croreDay 39 (6th Monday): Rs 8.25 croreDay 40 (6th Tuesday): Rs 8.25 croreDay 41 (6th Wednsday): Rs 6 croreTotal: Rs 237.13 crore‘Hanuman Ansh’ day 40 occupancyOn Tuesday, the overall occupancy rate was 28.65%, which declined to 17.19% on Wednesday. As compared to the previous day’s morning show occupancy rate of 14.85%, on day 41, the film began with 12.85% footfall. 27.31% was the rate during afternoon shows on Tuesday, whereas Wednesday recorded 15.92% occupancy in the same time slot. Evening shows saw some growth with 19.00% occupancy, and the night shows recorded the highest rate of 21%.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. articles.title: 'Mirzapur The Movie' box office collection Day 14 [LIVE]: Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan film chases Rs 200 crore milestone and Rs 300 crore worldwide despite second week slump
articles.summary: 'Mirzapur The Movie' stands on the brink of a major milestone as it enters Day 14, with its India net collection now at Rs. 199.73 crore, just a whisk.
articles.body: 'Mirzapur The Movie' stands on the brink of a major milestone as it enters Day 14, with its India net collection now at Rs. 199.73 crore, just a whisker away from the Rs. 200 crore mark. The Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan starrer has been running on fumes as far as daily collections go, but its overall tally has held firm enough to guarantee entry into the coveted domestic 200-crore club, with the worldwide gross now closing in on Rs. 287 crore. Having spent the better part of its third week adding small but steady numbers, the film now finds itself just a fraction away from a milestone that will cement its place among the year's stronger domestic performers.Once that benchmark is crossed, attention will shift towards the film's next domestic total and whether it can maintain enough theatrical momentum to add several more crores in its third week. On the global front, the film has Rs 13.36 crore to cover before reaching the Rs 300 crore worldwide mark. The Rs 300 crore global milestone would require the film to maintain a reasonable pace across its remaining theatrical run, particularly as weekday collections have begun to moderate.'Mirzapur The Movie' Day 1 to Day 13 earningsThe film began its theatrical run with Rs. 25.75 crore on Day 1, followed by Rs. 32 crore on Day 2 and Rs. 36 crore on Day 3. It then collected Rs. 16 crore on Day 4, Rs. 15.60 crore on Day 5, Rs. 12.55 crore on Day 6 and Rs. 10.55 crore on Day 7, ending its opening week at Rs. 148.45 crore India net.The second week added Rs. 9.50 crore on Day 8, Rs. 13.50 crore on Day 9, Rs. 13.25 crore on Day 10, Rs. 5.50 crore on Day 11 and another Rs. 5.50 crore on Day 12. Day 13 contributed Rs. 3.75 crore, taking the cumulative domestic net to Rs. 199.45 crore.‘Mirzapur The Movie’ overseas collection and worldwide totalOverseas, the film opened with Rs. 4.25 crore on Day 1 and followed it with Rs. 6 crore on Day 2 and Rs.7 crore on Day 3. Days 4 to 7 contributed Rs. 2.50 crore, Rs. 3.50 crore, Rs. 2 crore and Rs. 2.50 crore respectively. The film then added Rs. 2.50 crore on Day 8 and Rs. 4 crore each on Days 9 and 10.The overseas tally subsequently moved to Rs. 47 crore after Day 11, Rs. 48 crore after Day 12 and Rs. 49 crore after Day 13, according to the figures provided. With the India gross at Rs. 237.64 crore after Day 13, the worldwide gross stood at Rs. 286.64 crore.'Mirzapur The Movie' Day 14 collection live trackingAs per Sacnilk, 'Mirzapur The Movie' is currently playing across 2,210 shows on Day 14, having added Rs. 0.28 crore so far in the day.This takes the film's overall India gross to Rs. 237.97 crore and its India net to Rs. 199.73 crore, with the final Day 14 figure expected once all shows have concluded.Day wise collections for 'Mirzapur The Movie'Week 1: Rs. 148.45 croreDay 8: Rs. 9.50 croreDay 9: Rs. 13.50 croreDay 10: Rs. Rs. 13.25 croreDay 11: Rs. 5.50 croreDay 12: Rs. 5.50 croreDay 13: Rs. 3.75 croreDay 14 [LIVE]: Rs. 0.28 croreTOTAL: Rs. 199.73 croreMore about 'Mirzapur The Movie'Directed by Gurmmeet Singh and written by Puneet Krishna, 'Mirzapur The Movie' takes the franchise from the streaming platform to the big screen. The story revolves around the continuing battle for control of 'Mirzapur,' with old rivalries resurfacing and new threats emerging in the struggle for power. The official CBFC synopsis describes the story as a battle for the throne of Mirzapur involving blood debts and competing forces seeking control of the city's violent underworld.The film brings back several familiar faces from the franchise, led by Pankaj Tripathi as Kaleen Bhaiya, Ali Fazal as Guddu Pandit and Divyendu Sharma as Munna Tripathi. The ensemble also includes Rasika Dugal, Jitendra Kumar, Abhishek Banerjee, Ravi Kishan, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Sonal Chauhan, Mohit Malik, Sheeba Chadha, Rajesh Tailang, Harshita Shekhar Gaur, Shweta Tripathi, Sushant Singh and others.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources.
